subject: Geopolitics
title: HUMINT: Human Spies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on HUMINT: Human Spies.

hook.text: Aldrich Ames sold CIA secrets to Russia for $2.7 million. He betrayed every US spy in Moscow. Most were executed.

buildup.text: HUMINT — human intelligence — means recruiting people with access to secrets and convincing them to share.

discovery.text: Motivations vary: money, ideology, coercion, or ego. CIA uses the acronym MICE to assess potential recruits.

twist.text: HUMINT is high-risk. A single mole can destroy an entire network. Trust is both the tool and the vulnerability.

climax.text: Despite satellites and cyber tools, human spies remain irreplaceable. Only people can reveal intentions and plans.

punchline.text: Technology reads data. Only humans read minds.

quiz.question: What does the CIA acronym MICE stand for in spy recruitment?
